The collagen is fish-derived. Glucose syrup, sugar and glucose are listed, alongside pectin and passion fruit flavor. The directions specify two gummies daily.

faqs.question: Do the gummies contain biotin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Biotin is listed with vitamins, minerals, fish-derived collagen and other ingredients. Individual vitamin and mineral amounts are not stated in the supplied ingredient list.

faqs.question: Are they vegan or sugar-free?
faqs.answer: No. The formula contains fish-derived collagen, glucose syrup, sugar and glucose.

faqs.question: How many do I take?
faqs.answer: Take two gummies daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional. Do not exceed the suggested dosage and read the full warnings before use.

faqs.answer: Yes. Tell your clinician about all supplements. Biotin can interfere with certain laboratory tests, and your clinician can advise whether any pause is needed.

routine.title: Make it part of your day.

steps.title: Take two
steps.body: Take two gummies daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

steps.title: Stay within the serving
steps.body: Do not exceed the suggested use. Check overlap with other vitamin supplements.

steps.title: Keep them safely stored
steps.body: Keep out of reach of children in a cool, dry place. They are supplements, not sweets.

expectations.title: Nutrition is the foundation.
expectations.body: These gummies complement nutrient intake. Biotin is not a guaranteed hair-growth treatment, and additional biotin has limited evidence for hair, skin or nail changes in people who already get enough.

education.title: What biotin does—and what research can tell us.
education.body: Biotin helps the body use carbohydrates, fats and proteins. Evidence for improving hair, skin and nails with extra biotin is limited in people without a deficiency. Nutritional support should not be mistaken for a guaranteed visible result.
education.scope: Ingredient education. This is not a clinical study of the IQON formula.
